newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lam Soon Food in rights, pref shrs issues.
newsitem.headline: Lam Soon Food in rights, pref shrs issues.

text.p: Lam Soon Food Industries Ltd has announced a three-for-one rights issue, a share consolidation, and the issue of HK$500 million in convertible, non-cumulative preference shares, the company said.

In an announcement published on Thursday, the company proposed to raise about HK$671 million to HK$689 million before expenses by way of a rights issue of a minimum of 1,918.56 million and a maximum of 1,967.94 million rights shares.
The company also planned a share consolidation of 20 shares into one following the rights issue.
